description: Screens one text for prompt-injection patterns in English (instruction override, role or system-prompt extraction, jailbreak personas, hidden or encoded instructions) using a fixed rule list based on OWASP LLM01 categories. Returns HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/NONE, each match, and the text with matches removed. A rule list misses rewording and other languages: treat NONE as no known pattern, not as safe. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
